questions.title: String Length and Characters
questions.description: Write a Java program that takes the string 'Hello, Java!' and prints: its length, the first character, the last character, and the character at index 7.
constraints: Print all four pieces of information

examples.output:
String: Hello, Java!
Length: 12
First char: H
Last char: !
Char at 7: J

questions.expectedOutput:
Length: 12
First char: H
Last char: !
Char at 7: J

questions.title: String Comparison
questions.description: Write a Java program that compares two strings 'Java' and 'java'. Demonstrate the difference between == and equals(), and also use equalsIgnoreCase().

examples.output:
str1 == str2: false
str1.equals(str2): false
str1.equalsIgnoreCase(str2): true

questions.title: String Manipulation
questions.description: Write a Java program that takes '  Hello World  ' and performs: trim whitespace, convert to uppercase, convert to lowercase, replace 'World' with 'Java', and get substring from index 0 to 5.

examples.output:
Original: '  Hello World  '
Trimmed: 'Hello World'
Uppercase: 'HELLO WORLD'
Lowercase: 'hello world'
Replaced: 'Hello Java'
Substring: 'Hello'

hints: Chain methods or store in new variables
questions.expectedOutput:
Trimmed: Hello World
Uppercase: HELLO WORLD
Lowercase: hello world

questions.title: Word Counter
questions.description: Write a Java program that counts the number of words in the sentence 'Java is a powerful programming language'. Use split() method with space as delimiter.
constraints: Display each word and total count

examples.output:
Sentence: Java is a powerful programming language
Words:
1. Java
2. is
...
Total words: 6

questions.title: Palindrome Checker
questions.description: Write a Java program that checks if 'radar' is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards). Use StringBuilder to reverse the string and compare.

examples.output:
radar is a palindrome: true
hello is a palindrome: false

questions.expectedOutput:
radar is a palindrome: true
hello is a palindrome: false
